items.title: Chevron Reportedly Nears $5 Billion Deal to Acquire Majority Stake in Beacon Offshore Energy
items.summary: Chevron Corp (NYSE:CVX) is reportedly close to reaching an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Beacon Offshore Energy in a transaction valued at approximately $5 billion, according to a Financial Times report published on Monday. The US oil producer has moved ahead of competing bidders in the acquisition process, although a final agreement has not yet been announced.
